newsitem.title: GREECE: AEK-ATHENS RANKS 31ST, PAO 70TH IN WORLD SOCCER.
newsitem.headline: AEK-ATHENS RANKS 31ST, PAO 70TH IN WORLD SOCCER.

text.p: Greece's AEK soccer club ranked 31st with 172 points and Panathinaikos 70th with 130 points in world soccer rankings in March, according to the International Federation of Football History Statistics (IFFHS).
Italy's Juventus led all world soccer powerhouses with 367.5 points followed by Inter of Milan in second place with 257 points in March.
The rankings are based on all international, friendly and national league matches played by soccer clubs for the last year to March 1997.
No other Greek soccer club made it to the world's top 150 clubs.
The IFFHS rankings were published in Friday's Sportime and Ora sports dailies. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
